headline.text: Biggest risk: unreliable weight readings. Roughly 27% of buyers mention it.

dealbreakers.name: Unreliable weight readings
dealbreakers.quote: Every morning it tells me I weigh 164.3 pounds.  It never changes.

dealbreakers.name: Power and on/off problems
dealbreakers.quote: it gave me an ominous "Lo" message, that really should mean low battery, except replacing the battery/resetting the scale/doing everything humanly possible with a scale didn't fix it.

dealbreakers.name: Fragile construction
dealbreakers.quote: The corner of the scale barely tapped against the side of my bathtub and the whole thing shattered.

dealbreakers.name: Surface and stability issues
dealbreakers.quote: one of 4 sensors was not properly inserted in it's mount place

checklist.action: Place scale on flat surface, press power button, verify it turns on and displays weight
checklist.why: Buyers report it often never powers up

checklist.action: Turn on, press any reset/calibration button, ensure scale zeroes before weighing
checklist.why: Calibration often stuck at a weight

checklist.action: Place scale on carpet and hardwood, step on each corner, observe reading changes
